info.name: Denon MC3000
info.author: Bertrand Espern, Gr33nR10t, updated for Mixxx 2.5
info.description: Full 4-deck mapping for the Denon DJ MC3000. Per-side SHIFT layer, all four MIDI channels mapped, 14-bit pitch faders, hot cues, loops, effect units, samplers and LED feedback.
